The C2 straight-branch fixture is the diagonal-lift family of ssi_fixtures reframed: S1 = (u,v,u) (plane z=x) against S2 = (s,t,0.5) (horizontal plane). Their product-space zero set is the straight line {u=0.5, s=0.5, v=t} tangent to the (v,t) chart plane. This geometry keeps the axis-aligned hull of the swept slice thin so the layered-Bernstein-hull dependency conservatism stays inside a certifyable perpendicular box at tau width ~0.1; a 45-degree (1,1,1,1) branch would inflate the image beyond the (0,1)^4 chart capacity at the same width.

The Krawczyk image K for both C1 and the C2 is built exactly per Lemma 8.0 / Theorem 8.1 with CertifiedInterval (every op widened by next_down/next_up), the preconditioner is the interval inverse of the midpoint Jacobian (adjugate over determinant, 2x2 and 3x3), and the box-radii contraction rate is rho = max_i (M r)_i / r_i. The rho test replicates the engine's arithmetic op-for-op in the test (M and r computed by hand) and asserts bit equality of the resulting rate.

Emission/backing table implemented as specified: C1 - empty w -> WeightDegenerate Disproven; zero/non-finite radius -> NonFinite Disproven; K strictly inside -> Proven (rho <= RHO_MAX else Inconclusive); K disjoint -> Disproven ClaimRefuted (no root in the box); overlap-not-strict -> Inconclusive; midpoint Jacobian singular / non-finite enclosure -> Inconclusive. C2 - empty w -> WeightDegenerate Disproven; non-strict perpendicular image -> Inconclusive (never Disproven, shrink-and-retry licensed); conditioning beyond KAPPA_MAX -> Inconclusive (Conditioning).
